limitations: single seed and one new Perlin test family; official small input macro
no distinguishable harmful training action; 8 strong pairs from PC1 S0 only
validation minimum regret tied, all saved at first update; last-epoch calibration not deployed
hierarchical package adds shared local block, pooling and role-read parameters; not capacity matched
S2 observation-only block excluded from q-active modules; embedding tables counted whole
root-log intervals are resolution rules, not confidence probabilities
summary_s is inside encoding_s; candidate_read_s is inside network_s; do not add nested costs twice
coarse lowering lineage unchanged; no new continuation or optimal-policy value claim
matrix validation default is about 0.807 ms including startup; only one harmful-by-resolution candidate, so checkpoint discrimination is weak and its label is not statistical significance.
